q1.sampleAnswer: My name is Wang Fang. I’m twelve years old. I live in Chengdu, in China. I take photos two or three times a week, usually with my mum’s phone. I share my photos with my family and my best friend. My favourite photo is of my grandparents in their garden. I took it last summer. They are smiling and there are lots of flowers behind them, so I really like it. I usually eat eggs and bread for breakfast, and I drink a glass of milk. My favourite fruit is watermelon because it’s sweet and it’s great in hot weather.

keyPoints.descZh: 语法与词汇：简单语法结构的掌握，日常话题词汇的运用
互动交流：回答切题，内容充分，能延展回答
整体表现：能用简单的语言完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答能直接回答每个问题，并多说一两句细节或理由（例如多久拍一次照、照片里有谁、在哪里拍的、为什么喜欢），用简单正确的句子连贯表达。

q2.sampleAnswer: I like comics because they have lots of pictures and they’re easy to read. I don’t really like newspapers, they’re a bit boring for me. I think reading newspapers is a good idea for adults, because you can learn about the news. Reading comics is easy because the pictures help you understand the story. Reading text messages is fun when they’re from my friends. Cook books are useful if you want to make a cake. I think reading maps is difficult, because I often get lost! I like comics best. I prefer reading a book to watching a film, because I can imagine the people and places. The best book I’ve ever read is Harry Potter, because the story is exciting.

q2.explanationZh: 好的回答会对图片中每种读物（报纸、漫画、短信、菜谱、地图）说出喜欢与否并给出理由，能回答考官的追问，说出最喜欢哪一种，并用 because 等连接词把想法展开。
